verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a user-facing off-ramp: an individual sells crypto in the widget and picks a payout method or bank account. It also shows enterprise auto-conversion in the opposite direction, from incoming fiat into stablecoins. Nothing documents a merchant option to accept crypto payments and automatically settle stablecoin receipts into a fiat balance or bank payout, so the off-ramp is only an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can take crypto payments but settle in fiat — a documented option to auto-convert stablecoin receipts into a fiat balance or bank payout so my books never hold crypto
